about: Final-year BSc IT student at the University of Johannesburg (Informatics and Computer Science). projects.title: NdalamoPDF
projects.tagline: A free PDF toolkit for Windows that works offline.
summary: NdalamoPDF puts everyday PDF jobs in one desktop app: merge, split, compress (including down to a size limit for upload portals), convert to and from Word, Excel, pictures and Markdown, OCR for scans, sign, redact, fill forms, protect and compare.
Everything runs on the PC, so files never leave it. It comes with its own Java runtime and installs in one step, with an optional LibreOffice install for converting Office files.
highlights: PDF to Word that keeps the original fonts, spacing, tables and pictures.
Pipelines and watch folders that run several tools on files automatically.
A Microsoft Word add-in that adds Delete Page to the ribbon and right-click menu.
A Windows setup with the terms, options and a single install for the app, the add-in and LibreOffice.

projects.title: Event RSVP and Ticketing System
projects.tagline: Registration, proof of payment and QR tickets for an event.
summary: A web app where guests register, upload proof of payment and receive a QR ticket by email.
highlights: Check-in secured with HMAC-signed QR codes, verified by an Android admin app so tickets can't be forged.
Built for a youth gala that was later cancelled.
